resources.string: No frequent players yet. Add friends here so they can join from the main screen with one tap.

Only two players remain and the Demon is still alive
%1$s was the Saint, so good loses immediately.
The Mayor win condition triggered, so good wins.
Choose a player whose actual alignment is good. The Fortune Teller may be the red herring.
There is no suitable red herring candidate right now. Go back and check the player state.
Only choose this if the Ravenkeeper died tonight.
There are no Minions in play.
There are no Minions in play. Keep this step to preserve first-night rhythm.
There is no Demon right now. This usually only happens after resolution effects.
In 5/6-player games, evil players do not receive first-night evil team info or Demon bluffs. Keep this step to preserve first-night rhythm.
In small games, Minions and the Demon do not learn each other on the first night, and the Demon does not receive 3 bluff characters.

Tap %1$s and signal them to open their eyes. If there are multiple Minions, let them recognize each other first; then tap “Show full screen to player” and show the phone only to the awakened player(s).

Tap %1$s and signal the Demon to open their eyes. Tap “Show full screen to player” and show only the Demon their Minions and bluff characters; then take the phone back and signal them to close their eyes.
Do not wake any player. Pause for 2-3 seconds, then tap next.
On the first night, Minions learn who the Demon is and recognize each other.
On the first night, the Demon learns who the Minions are and receives bluff characters. The Demon does not kill on night 1.
Choose one player other than the Monk. If the Demon attacks that player tonight, announce no death at dawn.
